---
title: "Attendance Record"
---

```{r}
#| label: attendance-record-images
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(knitr)

# Folder located alongside this QMD file
chapter_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
image_dir <- file.path(chapter_dir, "21_attendance_record")

# Find attendance-record images
images <- list.files(
  image_dir,
  pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

# Sort images by filename
images <- sort(images)

if (length(images) == 0L) {
  cat("*No attendance-record images found.*\n\n")
} else {
  for (image in images) {
    image_path <- normalizePath(image, winslash = "/")

    # Use a path relative to the QMD directory
    relative_path <- file.path(
      "21_attendance_record",
      basename(image_path)
    )
    relative_path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", relative_path)

    # Insert image without a caption
    cat(
      "![](<", relative_path, ">){width=95%}\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
}
```
